The ledger holds $26,695 for this posting. The reader marks it all-in, so the purchase price used by budget and rank stays $1,498 below the price at the desk, which is the gap this task exists to close. I found this in 1 of 85 fee-itemizing pages I matched to the ledger by VIN; the other 84 stored the total. The price extraction was there before this diff, but \\u0060ReadAutotrader\\u0060 already finds the \\u0022Total Price\\u0022 line, so the walk could use it to catch or correct the stored
